title: Freya and the Witness
author: August Lockridge
blurb: Tamsin Joubert, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
